svg.text: Cut list (frame cut picture in the plan gives every position):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 legs 700; 4 side rails 850 (top pair and lower pair, 255 up);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 top end rails, low end member (90 up), head member (600 up), 550;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 members 600 laid across: gearbox pair, spindle pair on top of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the lower rails, tub pair hung on 4 drop posts 205 at 445 up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tank post member 550, end post 560, tank post 545. 14.5 m in all.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tack on a flat floor, check diagonals within 2 mm, then weld.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bearing plates 150 x 130 x 6, 40 mm centre hole, four 11 mm holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 70 apart: one under the spindle pair, one under the tub pair,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centres in line (plumb bob) before welding.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tank cradle 250 x 250 x 5 on the tank post, two gussets each way.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the bolt holes each later section lists; prime and paint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: frame sits on all four feet; bearing plate holes in line.
